bugs.name: Schistosoma haematobium
bugs.disease: Painless blood at the end of the stream in a Nile delta farmer
bugs.micro: Freshwater blood fluke (trematode) needing a snail host; free-swimming cercariae pierce skin and adults live in the venous plexus around the bladder; large oval eggs with a sharp terminal spine in urine; eosinophilia; praziquantel
bugs.presentation: 24-year-old man who has waded daily in Nile irrigation canals since boyhood: 8 months of visible blood at the end of urination without pain, with frequency and suprapubic fullness. Eosinophils 11%; urine sediment holds large oval parasite eggs; routine culture is sterile.

bugs.name: Schistosoma haematobium
bugs.disease: Keratinizing bladder tumor after decades of canal exposure
bugs.micro: Freshwater blood fluke of northeastern Africa and the Middle East; eggs lodge in the bladder wall and the chronic granulomatous reaction drives dysplasia, then cancer, 70% of it keratinizing rather than urothelial; eggs in urine or tissue
bugs.presentation: 56-year-old Egyptian man who farmed irrigated land all his life, with 30 years of intermittent bloody urine: now 3 months of worsening frequency and pelvic pain. Cystoscopy: a firm ulcerated 5-cm mass; biopsy shows nests of keratinizing cells and calcified egg shells.

bugs.name: BK polyomavirus
bugs.disease: Bloody cystitis weeks after a stem cell transplant
bugs.micro: Small non-enveloped circular double-stranded DNA virus; infects most people silently in childhood, lies latent in urothelium and kidney, and reactivates under immunosuppression; quantitative PCR of urine and blood; not cultured
bugs.presentation: 29-year-old woman on day 45 after an allogeneic stem cell transplant, on immunosuppression: 5 days of severe burning, urgency every 20 minutes and clots of blood in the urine. T 37.5 C; urine: 300 RBC/hpf, no growth on bacterial culture; urine PCR shows a high viral load.
